HomeHeading: Where do you want to play?
HomeDescription: Select a display and choose what it does. Displays you turn off are restored automatically when you leave the game.
TourRoleDescription: With a display selected, choose whether to play on it, turn it off while you play, or leave it on. Displays you turn off are restored when you leave.
TourPlayDescription: Your displays switch and Big Picture opens on the TV. The first time, the TV asks you to confirm that you can see the image; if nobody responds within 15 sec, everything is restored. Close Big Picture to leave.
RunningInTray: You can close this window; Console Mode will keep running in the system tray.
SettingsIntro: Changes are saved automatically. Choose displays on the home screen.
HideOtherScreensCard: How to turn off other displays
HideOtherScreensDescription: Disconnecting is fastest. The black screen keeps the layout unchanged; DDC/CI turns off the panel through its hardware.
HdrDescription: Enabled on entry and restored to its previous state on exit.
VrrDescription: Enables the Windows setting. Also enable it in the NVIDIA/AMD control panel.
UiModeDescription: Console: big cards and controller navigation, full screen. Automatic picks Console when a controller is connected.
BackgroundDescription: Covers of your installed Steam games under a gradient, just the gradient, or a picture of your own.
SoundsDescription: Soft sounds when you move, pick and go back in the console interface.
ControllerHintDesktop: Controller detected · A navigates, Y opens console mode
SessionMenuHint: Your session menu shortcut opens this menu at any time.
SessionHintBody: Hold {0} to open the panel over the game.
SessionMenuDescription: During a session, hold this shortcut to open a menu over the game: volume, resolution, audio, FPS, HDR, back to the PC or exit. Does not work over exclusive-fullscreen games.
ConsoleSettingsHint: Press A on a row to change its value. Everything is saved right away.
ControlFsOpen: Browse your files with the controller
ControlFsMissing: Not installed · press to download and install
ControlFsInstallFailed: Couldn't install · press to open the download page
ControlFsMissingNote: ControlFS is not installed. Opening its download page in the browser.
SwitcherCloseConfirmBody: If there are unsaved changes, the app may still ask you to save them.
ConsoleActiveHint: Or hold {0} on the controller for 1 second.
HomeButtonCard: Controller shortcut to open Console Mode
HomeButtonDescription: With the app in the tray, hold this shortcut for 1 second to enter console mode (a single press if you turn on the short press below). Works with Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
ExitShortcutCard: Controller shortcut to go back to the PC
ExitShortcutDescription: During a session, hold this shortcut for 1 second to restore your desk and go back to the PC.
ControllerLayoutDescription: Automatic follows the connected controller. You can also lock the Xbox or PlayStation symbols.
ShortcutPressButtons: Hold the buttons, then let go…
ShortcutCaptureHint: Release to save. Press {0} alone to cancel.
ShortcutNotAllowed: Use two or more buttons together (like Select + Y), or the Home button alone. A single button would fire in the middle of a game.
ShortcutInUse: {0} is already the shortcut for "{1}". Pick a different combination.
ShortcutsOnboardingBody: No shortcut is on until you choose it. Pick a button or combination for each action, or leave it without one. Press Set, hold the buttons and let go. The same combination can't be used for two actions. You can change all of this later in Settings.
CloseSteamCard: Send Steam to the tray when going back to the PC
CloseSteamDescription: When you leave Big Picture, Steam receives a normal window-close request so it can move to the tray without exiting the process. If a game is running or its state cannot be checked, the window is left unchanged.
AutoStartControllerDescription: With the app in the tray, turning on or plugging in a controller enters console mode. Ignores the first 15 s after opening and 30 s after restoring.
HomeButtonShortPressCard: Short press of the Xbox button
HomeButtonShortPressDescription: Just press it, no holding. Turns off the controller shortcut for Game Bar in Windows (Win+G keeps working).
HomeButtonSteamHint: Steam is open and also uses the Xbox button. In Steam, turn off "Guide button focuses Steam" for the short press to work.
GameBarSettingError: Could not change the Game Bar setting: {0}
StartupDescription: Opens in the system tray when your PC starts, ready for the one-click shortcut.
NotifyUpdatesCard: Notify me when a new version is available
NotifyUpdatesDescription: Checks GitHub releases when the app starts.
BetaUpdatesDescription: Get early versions before everyone else to help test them. They can have bugs. Turning this off doesn't go back to the stable version: you'll get the next stable one when it comes out.
BetaUpdatesWarning: Test versions can fail on some setups. If something breaks, download the stable version from the releases page and tell us with the feedback button.
TvConfirmationDescription: The first time you use a new gaming display, the TV asks you to confirm that you can see the image. Respond with a mouse, keyboard, or controller (Xbox: A/B · PlayStation: ✕/○). Test it here without changing your displays.
TvControlCard: Turn the TV on and switch input
TvNoneDescription: When console mode starts, the app turns the TV on and switches it to the PC's input; on restore it can put it in standby.
TvAndroidDescription: Over the network, nothing to install. On the TV: Settings → System → Developer options → turn on "USB debugging" (or "Network debugging"). The first time, accept "Allow debugging" on the TV.
TvHostDescription: The TV's IP on your network (Settings → Network). Tip: reserve it in your router so it doesn't change.
TvMacDescription: To wake the TV from deep standby (Wake-on-LAN). Leave it empty if the TV answers while off.
TvHdmiDescription: The TV's HDMI port the PC is plugged into.
TvInputCommandDescription: Only if the TV ignores the HDMI key: an Android shell command that switches to the PC's input. Empty = the HDMI key chosen above.
TvTurnOffCard: Put the TV in standby on restore
TvTurnOffDescription: After the desk screens are back.
TvTestDescription: Turns the TV on and switches to the PC's input now, without touching the screens. The first time, it pairs with the TV.
TvTesting: Talking to the TV… If it asks, accept on the TV screen.
TvTestSuccess: The TV answered: it should now be on, on the PC's input.
TvTestFailure: Could not talk to the TV: {0}
TvTestTimedOut: The TV did not finish responding within 90 seconds. Try again.
TvNotConfigured: Choose how to control the TV.
TvUnreachable: The TV at {0} didn't answer. Check the IP, that the TV is on the same network and that debugging is on.
TvAdbNotAllowed: The TV didn't allow this PC. Press Test again and choose "Always allow" + "Allow" on the TV.
TvAdbTlsUnsupported: The TV only accepts "Wireless debugging" (pairing with a code). Turn on "USB debugging" / "Network debugging" in Developer options.
ControllerTestDescription: Shows live what Windows delivers from each controller: source, buttons by index, D-pad and sticks. Use it when a pad shows up but does nothing.
ControllerTestSteamHint: Steam running with PlayStation support captures the pad and the app gets nothing. Close Steam (or turn off PlayStation support in Steam Input) and test again.
DiagnosticsCopied: Diagnostics copied. Paste them into the issue or the feedback form.
TutorialDescription: Show the home screen walkthrough again.
OneClickDescription: Creates "Console Mode 1 Click" on your desktop, next to the regular app shortcut. It enters console mode directly without opening this window.
DataFolderDescription: Settings, display backup, and the log file (consolemode.log).
LanguageDescription: Choose the language used in Console Mode.
ConfirmDescription: This is the gaming display. Confirm with your mouse, keyboard, or controller. If nobody responds, your displays will be restored automatically.
AudioHint: Applied on entry and restored on exit. "When connected" switches automatically when the TV appears.
LaunchPlayniteDescription: Opens Playnite in fullscreen. Your displays are restored automatically when you close it.
LaunchXboxDescription: Experimental: sends Win+F11. To restore your displays, use the app or system tray menu.
LaunchSteamDescription: Opens Steam Big Picture. Your displays are restored automatically when you close it.
FocusChoose: Choose a gaming display on the home screen.
FocusApplied: Applied to {0} on entry and reverted on exit.
PlaynitePathDetected: Found automatically at {0}. Pick Playnite.FullscreenApp.exe if you use the portable version.
PlaynitePathMissing: Playnite not found. Pick Playnite.FullscreenApp.exe (portable version, for example).
PlaynitePathPickError: Could not open the file picker: {0}
FpsOverlayDescription: Shows the FPS over the game during a session, through RTSS. Except on "Afterburner", MSI Afterburner's OSD is hidden while console mode is on.
FpsAvailable: Applies to all games while console mode is active. Uses RTSS.
FpsUnavailable: Optional. Install RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS) to use this feature.
NoGameDisplayConfigured: No gaming display is configured; unable to enter console mode.
AudioOnConnect: The one that appears when connected (TV)
ShortcutCreated: Created the "Console Mode 1 Click" desktop shortcut.
ChooseGameScreen: Choose the display you want to play on.
UnconfirmedSetup: Your displays were restored because the gaming display wasn't confirmed. Check your selection and try again.
ShortcutDescription: Enters console mode with one click
ShortcutUnavailable: WScript.Shell is unavailable on this version of Windows.
UpdateAssetMissing: This release doesn't have a verifiable asset for this installation type.
UpdateHashMismatch: The downloaded file's SHA-256 does not match the digest published by GitHub.
TourMapGeneric: These are your displays in their desktop positions. Select the display you want to play on.
TourMapWithFocus: These are your displays in their desktop positions. We chose {0} because it is currently turned off; select another if you prefer.
RestoreSuccess: Your displays are back to normal.
SummaryChooseScreen: Choose the display you want to play on
GameScreenDidNotTurnOn: The gaming display did not turn on. Check that the TV is on and set to the right HDMI input, then try again.
ActivePlaynite: Close Playnite to restore your displays automatically.
ActiveXbox: In Xbox mode, restoration is manual: use Restore now or the system tray menu.
ActiveSteam: Close Big Picture to restore your displays automatically.
StartupSettingError: Could not change the Windows startup setting: {0}
AppUpToDate: Console Mode is up to date.
NewVersionOnGithub: A new version is available on GitHub.
SessionTourInviteBody: A quick tour shows what each option does, including the difference between Back to the PC and Exit Console Mode. To see it later, press {0} here in the menu.
SessionTourBackToGameBody: Closes this menu and hands the controller back to the game, just as it was. {0} does the same from anywhere in the menu.
SessionTourControlFsBody: Opens ControlFS, a file explorer made for the controller, in full screen. If it isn't installed yet, the first press downloads and installs it.
SessionTourVolumeBody: Press {0} to adjust the volume of the audio output: ◀ ▶ change it in steps of 5, {1} mutes it, and {0} or {2} finish.
SessionTourDisplayBody: Resolution, refresh rate, audio output and HDR of the game screen. Whatever you change here lasts for this session only: back at the PC, everything goes back to how it was.
SessionTourDisplayPreviewBody: Resolution, refresh rate, audio output and HDR of the game screen. Outside a session, like now, whatever you change here stays until you change it again.
SessionTourFpsBody: The FPS limit caps the frame rate of your games and the counter shows the FPS in a corner of the screen, both through RivaTuner. Back at the PC, both are undone.
SessionTourWindowsBody: The open programs, like an Alt + Tab that is always on screen. {0} brings a window to the front; {1} asks it to close, once you confirm.
SessionTourBackToPcBody: Ends the session: screens, resolution, HDR, audio and the FPS limit go back to how they were, Big Picture closes and the TV turns off if you set that up. Console Mode stays open in the tray, ready for next time.
SessionTourCloseMenuBody: Outside a session there is nothing to restore, so this button only closes the menu. During a session it becomes Back to the PC and puts screens, audio and resolution back as they were.
SessionTourExitBody: Does everything Back to the PC does and also closes Console Mode: it leaves the tray and the controller shortcuts stop working until you open it again.
SessionTourExitPreviewBody: Closes Console Mode completely: it leaves the tray and the controller shortcuts stop working until you open it again.
SessionTourDescription: Explains each option of the menu over the game. Opens the menu as a preview, without starting a session.
